fn gt_count(xs: List[Int], t: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (gt_count([1, 5, 3, 8], 3) == 2)
  example (gt_count([], 0) == 0)
  example (gt_count([2, 2], 2) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..r] => if (h > t) then (1 + gt_count(r, t)) else gt_count(r, t) }
}

{
  gt_count(xs, t)

fn member(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Bool
  requires (x >= 1)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (member([1, 2, 3], 2) == true)
  example (member([1, 2, 3], 4) == false)
  example (member([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == x) or member(t, x)) }
}

fn search_from(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 1)
  ensures (result >= k)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (search_from([1, 2, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (search_from([3, 5], 1) == 1)
  example (search_from([], 1) == 1)
  example (search_from([1, 2, 3], 1) == 4)
{
  if member(xs, k) then search_from(xs, (k + 1)) else k
}

fn first_missing(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall x in xs: (x >= 1)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures not contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall i in 1..result: contains(xs, i)
  effects pure
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([1, 2, 3]) == 4)
{
  search_from(xs, 1)
}

  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))

fn below(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists y in xs: (y < x)))
  effects pure
  example (below([], 5) == 0)
  example (below([7, 2, 9, 4], 5) == 2)
  example (below([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h < x) then (1 + below(t, x)) else below(t, x) }
}

fn pick(pool: List[Int], cands: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(pool)
  requires forall y in cands: contains(pool, y)
  requires exists y in cands: (below(pool, y) == (k - 1))
  ensures contains(pool, result)
  ensures (below(pool, result) == (k - 1))
  effects pure
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], [7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], [7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == 4)
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], [7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (pick([7, 2, 9, 4], [7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (pick([5], [5], 1) == 5)
{
  match cands { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (below(pool, h) == (k - 1)) then h else pick(pool, t, k) }
}

fn kth_smallest(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires ((k >= 1) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures (below(xs, result) == (k - 1))
  effects pure
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 1) == 2)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 2) == 4)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 3) == 7)
  example (kth_smallest([7, 2, 9, 4], 4) == 9)
  example (kth_smallest([5], 1) == 5)
{
  pick(xs, xs, k)
}

  requires (((a - b) + b) == a)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result == (a - b)) or (result == (b - a)))
  effects pure
  example (abs_diff(1, 7) == 6)
  example (abs_diff(7, 1) == 6)
  example (abs_diff(5, 5) == 0)
{
  if (a >= b) then (a - b) else (b - a)
}

fn max2(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (((a - b) + b) == a)
  ensures ((result >= a) and (result >= b))
  ensures ((result == a) or (result == b))
  effects pure
  example (max2(3, 9) == 9)
  example (max2(9, 3) == 9)
  example (max2(4, 4) == 4)
{
  if (a >= b) then a else b
}

fn elem_at(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Int
  requires ((0 <= i) and (i < len(xs)))
  ensures (result == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (elem_at([5, 7], 1) == 7)
  example (elem_at([5, 7], 0) == 5)
  example (elem_at([1, 7, 4], 2) == 4)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then h else elem_at(t, (i - 1)) }
}

fn has_next(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Bool
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures (result == ((i + 1) < len(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (has_next([1, 7, 4], 0) == true)
  example (has_next([1, 7, 4], 1) == true)
  example (has_next([1, 7, 4], 2) == false)
  example (has_next([5, 5], 0) == true)
  example (has_next([5], 0) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [_, ..t] => match t { [] => false [_, ..u] => if (i == 0) then true else has_next(t, (i - 1)) } }
}

fn gap_at(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Int
  requires ((i >= 0) and ((i + 1) < len(xs)))
  ensures (result == abs_diff(xs[i], xs[(i + 1)]))
  effects pure
  example (gap_at([1, 7, 4], 0) == 6)
  example (gap_at([1, 7, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (gap_at([5, 5], 0) == 0)
{
  abs_diff(elem_at(xs, i), elem_at(xs, (i + 1)))
}

fn best_from(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Int
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures forall j in i..len(xs): (((j + 1) >= len(xs)) or (gap_at(xs, j) <= result))
  ensures ((((i + 1) >= len(xs)) and (result == 0)) or (exists j in i..len(xs): (((j + 1) < len(xs)) and (gap_at(xs, j) == result))))
  effects pure
  example (best_from([1, 7, 4], 0) == 6)
  example (best_from([1, 7, 4], 1) == 3)
  example (best_from([1, 7, 4], 2) == 0)
{
  if has_next(xs, i) then max2(gap_at(xs, i), best_from(xs, (i + 1))) else 0
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 2)

  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (((i + 1) >= len(xs)) or (abs_diff(xs[i], xs[(i + 1)]) <= result))
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): (((i + 1) < len(xs)) and (abs_diff(xs[i], xs[(i + 1)]) == result))

  example (max_gap([1, 7, 4]) == 6)

  example (max_gap([3, 1, 4, 1, 5]) == 4)

  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => best_from(xs, 0) }

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == count(xs, x))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == count(ys, y))
  effects pure

  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => xs [g, ..s] => if (h <= g) then ([h] ++ merge_sorted(t, ys)) else ([g] ++ merge_sorted(xs, s)) } }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) or (result[0] == (xs[0] + acc)))
  ensures forall i in 1..len(xs): (result[i] == (result[(i - 1)] + xs[i]))
  effects pure
  example (running([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (running([], 0) == [])
  example (running([4], 10) == [14])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([(acc + h)] ++ running(t, (acc + h))) }
}

fn take_first(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take_first([1, 2, 3], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take_first([1, 2, 3], 0) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take_first(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn drop_first(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop_first([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop_first([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop_first(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(xs) - k): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[((len(xs) - k) + i)] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
{
  (drop_first(xs, k) ++ take_first(xs, k))
}

  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop_first([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop_first([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop_first(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(xs) - k): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[((len(xs) - k) + i)] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
{
  (drop_first(xs, k) ++ take_first(xs, k))
}

  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [7]) == [12])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [k, ..u] => ([(h + k)] ++ zip_sum(t, h)) } }
}
